description: Source code for rdkIntegrationService, a C-based service handling activation, configuration, and service management for a device, including AWS and userver channels, with callback functions, event handling, and system control logic.

methods.name: printUsage
methods.description: Displays usage information for the service executable.

methods.name: handleCommOnlineChangedEvent
methods.description: Handles online status change events for communication channels.

methods.name: main
methods.description: Entry point for the service; initializes system, registers callbacks, and manages service lifecycle.

methods.name: setActivateCallback
methods.description: Handles activation requests with provided JSON payload.

methods.name: getStatusCallback
methods.description: Returns current activation status as a string.

methods.name: setSATCallback
methods.description: Sets activation using SAT token.

methods.name: shutdownBackgroundTask
methods.description: Performs system shutdown or reset in a background thread.

methods.name: resetToFactoryCallback
methods.description: Triggers factory reset asynchronously.

methods.name: restartCallback
methods.description: Triggers system restart asynchronously.

methods.name: getAwsIotEnabledCallback
methods.description: Checks if AWS IoT is enabled.

methods.name: setAwsIotEnabledCallback
methods.description: Enables or disables AWS IoT and manages related services.

methods.name: getUServerEnabledCallback
methods.description: Checks if UServer is enabled.

methods.name: setUServerEnabledCallback
methods.description: Enables or disables UServer and manages related services.

methods.name: getWhitelistURLCallback
methods.description: Retrieves the whitelist URL property.

methods.name: setWhitelistURLCallback
methods.description: Sets the whitelist URL property.

methods.name: getAWSEndpointCallback
methods.description: Retrieves the AWS endpoint property.

methods.name: setAWSEndpointCallback
methods.description: Sets the AWS endpoint property.

methods.name: getFirmwareDownloadURLCallback
methods.description: Retrieves the firmware download URL property.

methods.name: setFirmwareDownloadURLCallback
methods.description: Sets the firmware download URL property.

methods.name: getxPKICertIssuerCANameCallback
methods.description: Retrieves the PKI CA name property.

methods.name: setxPKICertIssuerCANameCallback
methods.description: Sets the PKI CA name property.

methods.name: startXbbServiceGroup
methods.description: Starts the XBB service group.

methods.name: startOnlineServiceGroup
methods.description: Starts the online service group.

methods.name: stopXbbServiceGroup
methods.description: Stops the XBB service group.

methods.name: stopOnlineServiceGroup
methods.description: Stops the online service group if both channels are disabled.

methods.name: setStatus
methods.description: Updates the device status property.

methods.name: activateAws
methods.description: Activates AWS using a SAT token, manages activation state, and retrieves account ID.
